name: saiku-telemetry
description: Anonymous install-count collector for Saiku (Cloudflare Worker + D1)

scripts.stats: wrangler d1 execute saiku-telemetry --remote --command "SELECT count(*) AS active_instances FROM installs WHERE last_seen > unixepoch()-2592000"
scripts.stats:versions: wrangler d1 execute saiku-telemetry --remote --command "SELECT version, count(*) AS n FROM installs WHERE last_seen > unixepoch()-2592000 GROUP BY version ORDER BY n DESC"
